name: Anniversary
overview: Anniversaries, including church anniversaries, provide an opportunity to reflect on God's faithful provision and guidance, as exemplified by the LORD being our shepherd who meets all our needs. The fellowship and unity celebrated in anniversaries echo the biblical principle that two are better than one, highlighting the blessing of shared labor and community. Central to these celebrations is the recognition of God's love demonstrated through Christ's sacrifice, offering everlasting life to all who believe. Above all, love binds believers together in perfect unity, making anniversaries a time to renew commitment to Christ-centered charity.
